verses.en: Verily I say unto you, my friends, I give unto you counsel, and a commandment, concerning all the properties which belong to the order which I commanded to be organized and established, to be a united order, and an everlasting order for the benefit of my church, and for the salvation of men until I come—
verses.sm: E Moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, a’u uo e, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou le fautuaga, ma se poloaiga, e uiga i meatotino uma a le faatulagaga na Ou poloaiina ia faatulaga ma faatuina, e avea o se faatulagaga autasi, ma o se faatulagaga tumau e faavavau mo le manuia o la’u ekalesia, ma mo le faaolataga o tagata seia Ou alu atu—

verses.en: With promise immutable and unchangeable, that inasmuch as those whom I commanded were faithful they should be blessed with a multiplicity of blessings;
verses.sm: Faatasi ma se folafolaga lē motusia ma lē masuia, e faapea, e tusa ai ma le faamaoni o i latou o e na Ou poloaiina o le a faamanuiaina ai i latou i faamanuiaga e tele;

verses.en: But inasmuch as they were not faithful they were nigh unto cursing.
verses.sm: Ae e tusa ai ma lo latou lē faamaoni sa toetoe a fetuuina ai i latou.

verses.en: Therefore, inasmuch as some of my servants have not kept the commandment, but have broken the covenant through covetousness, and with feigned words, I have cursed them with a very sore and grievous curse.
verses.sm: O lea, e tusa ai ma le lē tausia e ni isi o a’u auauna le poloaiga, ae ua latou solia le feagaiga e ala i le matape’ape’a, ma upu faatagāfai, ua Ou fetuu ai i latou i se fetuu tiga tele ma mamafa.

verses.en: For I, the Lord, have decreed in my heart, that inasmuch as any man belonging to the order shall be found a transgressor, or, in other words, shall break the covenant with which ye are bound, he shall be cursed in his life, and shall be trodden down by whom I will;
verses.sm: Aua o A’u, o le Alii, ua folafola i lo’u loto, e faapea, e tusa ai ma le maua o soo se tagata e auai i le faatulagaga o se solitulafono, pe, faapea, ua soli e ia le feagaiga ua fusia ai outou, o le a fetuuina o ia i lona olaga, ma o le a solia i lalo e e Ou te loto i ai;

verses.en: For I, the Lord, am not to be mocked in these things—
verses.sm: Aua o A’u, o le Alii, ia lē ulagia i nei mea—

verses.en: And all this that the innocent among you may not be condemned with the unjust; and that the guilty among you may not escape; because I, the Lord, have promised unto you a crown of glory at my right hand.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea atoa ina ia lē tausalaina e ua mamā i totonu o outou faatasi ma e amioletonu; ma ina ia lē sao e ua sala o i totonu o outou; aua o A’u, o le Alii, na folafola atu ia te outou se pale o le mamalu i lo’u lima taumatau.

verses.en: Therefore, inasmuch as you are found transgressors, you cannot escape my wrath in your lives.
verses.sm: O lea, e tusa ai ma le mauaina o outou o ni solitulafono, e lē mafai ona outou sao mai lo’u ita i o outou olaga.

verses.en: Inasmuch as ye are cut off for transgression, ye cannot escape the buffetings of Satan until the day of redemption.
verses.sm: E tusa ai ma le vavae eseina o outou ona o le solitulafono, e lē mafai ona outou sao i tu’iga a Satani seia oo i le aso o le togiolaina.

verses.en: And I now give unto you power from this very hour, that if any man among you, of the order, is found a transgressor and repenteth not of the evil, that ye shall deliver him over unto the buffetings of Satan; and he shall not have power to bring evil upon you.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu nei ia te outou le mana mai lenei lava itula, e faapea afai e i ai se tagata, o le faatulagaga, i totonu o outou, e maua o se solitulafono ma ua lē salamo i le leaga, ia outou tuu atu o ia i tu’iga a Satani; ma o le a lē maua e ia le mana e ’aumai ai le leaga i luga o outou.

verses.en: It is wisdom in me; therefore, a commandment I give unto you, that ye shall organize yourselves and appoint every man his stewardship;
verses.sm: O le poto lea ua ia te a’u; o lea, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia outou faatulaga outou lava ma tofi i tagata taitoatasi lana mea-tausi;

verses.en: That every man may give an account unto me of the stewardship which is appointed unto him.
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai e tagata taitoatasi ona tuu mai ia te a’u se tala o le mea-tausi ua tofi atu ia te ia.

verses.en: For it is expedient that I, the Lord, should make every man accountable, as a steward over earthly blessings, which I have made and prepared for my creatures.
verses.sm: Aua e tatau ia te A’u, o le Alii, ona faia tagata taitoatasi ia tali, o se tausimea i luga o faamanuiaga faaletino, ua Ou faia ma saunia mo o’u tagata.

verses.en: I, the Lord, stretched out the heavens, and built the earth, my very handiwork; and all things therein are mine.
verses.sm: O A’u, o le Alii, na fofolaina le lagi, ma fausia le lalolagi, o a’u galuega-taulima lava; o mea uma ua i ai i totonu e a a’u ia.

verses.en: And it is my purpose to provide for my saints, for all things are mine.
verses.sm: Ma o lo’u faamoemoe o le faia lea o mea mo la’u au paia, aua o mea uma e a a’u ia.

verses.en: But it must needs be done in mine own way; and behold this is the way that I, the Lord, have decreed to provide for my saints, that the poor shall be exalted, in that the rich are made low.
verses.sm: Peitai e tatau ona faia i la’u lava ala; ma faauta o le ala lenei ua folafola e A’u, o le Alii, e faia ai mea mo la’u au paia, e faaea ai e matitiva, ina ia faamaulaloina e mau’oa.

verses.en: For the earth is full, and there is enough and to spare; yea, I prepared all things, and have given unto the children of men to be agents unto themselves.
verses.sm: Aua ua tumu le lalolagi, ma ua lava ma totoe mea o i ai; ioe, na Ou saunia mea uma, ma ua tuu atu i le fanauga a tagata ia avea ma pule ia te i latou lava.

verses.en: Therefore, if any man shall take of the abundance which I have made, and impart not his portion, according to the law of my gospel, unto the poor and the needy, he shall, with the wicked, lift up his eyes in hell, being in torment.
verses.sm: O lea, afai e ave e se tagata se mea mai le tele o mea ua Ou faia, ma lē tuu atu lana vaega, i e matitiva ma e ua lē tagolima, e tusa ma le tulafono o la’u talalelei, o le a siitia a’e e ia ona mata faatasi ma e amioleaga i seoli, ua maua i le mafatia.

verses.en: And now, verily I say unto you, concerning the properties of the order—
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e faatatau i meatotino a le faatulagaga—

verses.en: Let my servant Sidney Rigdon have appointed unto him the place where he now resides, and the lot of the tannery for his stewardship, for his support while he is laboring in my vineyard, even as I will, when I shall command him.
verses.sm: Ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone ia tofi atu ia te ia le nofoaga o loo nofo ai nei o ia, ma le fasi fanua o le fale pa’u o manu, ma ana mea-tausi, mo lona tausiga a’o galue o ia i lo’u tovine, e pei lava ona Ou loto i ai, pe a Ou poloaiina o ia.

verses.en: And let all things be done according to the counsel of the order, and united consent or voice of the order, which dwell in the land of Kirtland.
verses.sm: Ma ia faia mea uma e tusa ai ma le fautuaga a le faatulagaga, ma le maliega aufaatasi po o le leo o le faatulagaga, o loo nonofo i le laueleele o Katelani.

verses.en: And this stewardship and blessing, I, the Lord, confer upon my servant Sidney Rigdon for a blessing upon him, and his seed after him;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei mea-tausi ma le faamanuiaga, ua faaee atu e A’u, o le Alii, i luga o la’u auauna o Sini Rikitone mo se faamanuiaga i luga o ia, ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia;

verses.en: And I will multiply blessings upon him, inasmuch as he will be humble before me.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i luga o ia, e tusa ai ma le faamaualalo o ia i o’u luma.

verses.en: And again, let my servant Martin Harris have appointed unto him, for his stewardship, the lot of land which my servant John Johnson obtained in exchange for his former inheritance, for him and his seed after him;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Matini Harisi ia tofi atu ia te ia, mo ana mea-tausi le fasi fanua lea na maua e la’u auauna o Ioane Ioanesone e fesuia’i ma lona tofi muamua, mo ia ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia;

verses.en: And inasmuch as he is faithful, I will multiply blessings upon him and his seed after him.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lona faamaoni, o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i luga o ia ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And let my servant Martin Harris devote his moneys for the proclaiming of my words, according as my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., shall direct.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Matini Harisi e tuuto atu ana tupe mo le folafolaina atu o a’u upu, e pei ona o le a faatonuina ai e la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti.

verses.en: And again, let my servant Frederick G. Williams have the place upon which he now dwells.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Frederick G. Williams ia maua e ia le nofoaga o loo nofo ai nei o ia.

verses.en: And let my servant Oliver Cowdery have the lot which is set off joining the house, which is to be for the printing office, which is lot number one, and also the lot upon which his father resides.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui ia maua e ia le fasi fanua lea ua tuu ese e sosoo atu ma le fale, lea o le a avea ma ofisa lomitusi, o le fasi fanua numera muamua lea, ma le fasi fanua foi o loo nofo ai lona tamā.

verses.en: And let my servants Frederick G. Williams and Oliver Cowdery have the printing office and all things that pertain unto it.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu i a’u auauna o Frederick G. Williams ma Oliva Kaotui le ofisa lomitusi ma mea uma e faatatau i ai.

verses.en: And this shall be their stewardship which shall be appointed unto them.
verses.sm: Ma o nei mea o le a avea ma a laua mea-tausi ia tofia atu ia te i laua.

verses.en: And inasmuch as they are faithful, behold I will bless, and multiply blessings upon them.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo laua faamaoni, faauta o le a Ou faamanuia, ma faateleina faamanuiaga i o laua luga.

verses.en: And this is the beginning of the stewardship which I have appointed them, for them and their seed after them.
verses.sm: Ma o le amataga lenei o le mea-tausi ua Ou tofia ia te i laua, mo i laua ma a laua fanau e mulimuli mai ia te i laua.

verses.en: And, inasmuch as they are faithful, I will multiply blessings upon them and their seed after them, even a multiplicity of blessings.
verses.sm: Ma, e tusa ai ma lo laua faamaoni, o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i o laua luga ma a laua fanau e mulimuli mai ia te i laua, o faamanuiaga faateleina lava.

verses.en: And again, let my servant John Johnson have the house in which he lives, and the inheritance, all save the ground which has been reserved for the building of my houses, which pertains to that inheritance, and those lots which have been named for my servant Oliver Cowdery.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Ioane Ioanesone ia maua e ia le fale o loo nofo ai o ia, ma le tofi, o mea uma vagana ai le fanua ua faapolopolo mo le fausia o o’u fale, e faatatau i lena tofi, ma fasi fanua na ua ta’ua mo la’u auauna o Oliva Kaotui.

verses.en: And inasmuch as he is faithful, I will multiply blessings upon him.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lona faamaoni, o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i ona luga.

verses.en: And it is my will that he should sell the lots that are laid off for the building up of the city of my saints, inasmuch as it shall be made known to him by the voice of the Spirit, and according to the counsel of the order, and by the voice of the order.
verses.sm: Ma o lo’u loto ia faatau atu e ia fasi fanua ua faataatitia ese mo le faatuina i luga o le aai o la’u au paia, e pei o le a faailoa atu ai ia te ia e le leo o le Agaga, ma e tusa ai ma le fautuaga a le faatulagaga, ma le leo o le faatulagaga.

verses.en: And this is the beginning of the stewardship which I have appointed unto him, for a blessing unto him and his seed after him.
verses.sm: Ma o le amataga lenei o le mea-tausi ua Ou tofia ia te ia, mo se faamanuiaga ia te ia ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And inasmuch as he is faithful, I will multiply a multiplicity of blessings upon him.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lona faamaoni, o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga faateleina i ona luga.

verses.en: And again, let my servant Newel K. Whitney have appointed unto him the houses and lot where he now resides, and the lot and building on which the mercantile establishment stands, and also the lot which is on the corner south of the mercantile establishment, and also the lot on which the ashery is situated.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Newel K. Whitney fale ma le fasi fanua o loo nofo ai nei o ia, ma le fasi fanua ma le fale o loo tu ai le faleoloa, ma le fasi fanua foi lea o loo i le tulimanu i saute o le faleoloa, ma le fasi fanua foi lea o loo i ai le aseru.

verses.en: And all this I have appointed unto my servant Newel K. Whitney for his stewardship, for a blessing upon him and his seed after him, for the benefit of the mercantile establishment of my order which I have established for my stake in the land of Kirtland.
verses.sm: Ma o nei mea uma ua Ou tofia i la’u auauna o Newel K. Whitney mo ana mea-tausi, mo se faamanuiaga i ona luga ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia, mo le manuia o le faleoloa o la’u faatulagaga lea ua Ou faatuina mo la’u siteki i le laueleele o Katelani.

verses.en: Yea, verily, this is the stewardship which I have appointed unto my servant N. K. Whitney, even this whole mercantile establishment, him and his agent, and his seed after him.
verses.sm: Ioe, e moni, o le mea-tausi lea, le faleoloa atoa lava lenei, ua Ou tofia ia te ia o la’u auauna o N. K. Whitney ma lona sui, ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia.

verses.en: And inasmuch as he is faithful in keeping my commandments, which I have given unto him, I will multiply blessings upon him and his seed after him, even a multiplicity of blessings.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lona faamaoni i le tausiga o a’u poloaiga, ua Ou tuu atu ia te ia, o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i ona luga ma ana fanau e mulimuli mai ia te ia, o se faatelega lava o faamanuiaga.

verses.en: And again, let my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., have appointed unto him the lot which is laid off for the building of my house, which is forty rods long and twelve wide, and also the inheritance upon which his father now resides;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia tuu atu i la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e tofi ia te ia le fasi fanua lea ua faataatia ese mo le fausiaina o lo’u fale, lea e fasefulu rota le umi ma e sefululua le lautele, ma le tofi foi o loo nofo ai nei lona tamā;

verses.en: And this is the beginning of the stewardship which I have appointed unto him, for a blessing upon him, and upon his father.
verses.sm: Ma o le amataga lenei o le mea-tausi ua Ou tofia ia te ia, mo se faamanuiaga i ona luga, ma i luga o lona tamā.

verses.en: For behold, I have reserved an inheritance for his father, for his support; therefore he shall be reckoned in the house of my servant Joseph Smith, Jun.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, ua Ou faapolopoloina se tofi mo lona tamā, mo lona tausiga; o lea o le a faitauina o ia i le aiga o la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti.

verses.en: And I will multiply blessings upon the house of my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., inasmuch as he is faithful, even a multiplicity of blessings.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou faateleina faamanuiaga i luga o le fale o la’u auauna o Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, e tusa ai ma lona faamaoni, o se faatelega lava o faamanuiaga.

verses.en: And now, a commandment I give unto you concerning Zion, that you shall no longer be bound as a united order to your brethren of Zion, only on this wise—
verses.sm: Ma lenei, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga e faatatau ia Siona, ia lē toe fusia outou o se faatulagaga autasi ma o outou uso i Siona, tau lava i le faapenei—

verses.en: After you are organized, you shall be called the United Order of the Stake of Zion, the City of Kirtland. And your brethren, after they are organized, shall be called the United Order of the City of Zion.
verses.sm: A uma ona faatulagaina o outou, ia ta’ua outou o le Faatulagaga Autasi o le Siteki o Siona, o le Aai o Katelani. Ma o o outou uso, a uma ona faatulagaina o i latou, ia ta’ua o le Faatulagaga Autasi o le Aai o Siona.

verses.en: And they shall be organized in their own names, and in their own name; and they shall do their business in their own name, and in their own names;
verses.sm: Ma ia faatulaga i latou i o latou lava igoa, ma i lo latou lava igoa; ma ia latou faia a latou auaunaga i lo latou lava igoa, ma i o latou lava igoa;

verses.en: And you shall do your business in your own name, and in your own names.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou faia a outou auaunaga i lo outou lava igoa, ma i o outou lava igoa.

verses.en: And this I have commanded to be done for your salvation, and also for their salvation, in consequence of their being driven out and that which is to come.
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou poloaiina lenei mea ina ia faia mo lo outou faaolataga, ma mo lo latou faaolataga foi, ona o le tutuliesea o i latou ma le mea o le a oo mai.

verses.en: The covenants being broken through transgression, by covetousness and feigned words—
verses.sm: Ona ua motusia le feagaiga e ala i le solitulafono, e ala i le matape’ape’a ma upu faatagāfai—

verses.en: Therefore, you are dissolved as a united order with your brethren, that you are not bound only up to this hour unto them, only on this wise, as I said, by loan as shall be agreed by this order in council, as your circumstances will admit and the voice of the council direct.
verses.sm: O lea, ua soloia ai outou o se faatulagaga autasi ma o outou uso, ua lē toe fusia ai outou ia te i latou vagana ai e oo mai i le itula nei, tau lava i le faapenei, e pei ona Ou fai atu, i nonogatupe e pei ona o le a malilie i ai lenei faatulagaga i le fono, e pei ona mafai e tusa ma o outou tulaga ma le mea e faatonuina e le leo o le aufono.

verses.en: And again, a commandment I give unto you concerning your stewardship which I have appointed unto you.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga e faatatau i la outou mea-tausi ua Ou tofi atu ia te outou.

verses.en: Behold, all these properties are mine, or else your faith is vain, and ye are found hypocrites, and the covenants which ye have made unto me are broken;
verses.sm: Faauta, o nei meatotino uma e a a’u ia, a lē o lea ua lē aoga lo outou faatuatua, ma ua fai outou o ni tagata faagutugutulua, ma ua motusia feagaiga na outou faia mai ia te a’u;

verses.en: And if the properties are mine, then ye are stewards; otherwise ye are no stewards.
verses.sm: Ma afai o meatotino e a a’u ia, o lona uiga o outou o tausimea; a lē o lea e lē o outou o ni tausimea.

verses.en: But, verily I say unto you, I have appointed unto you to be stewards over mine house, even stewards indeed.
verses.sm: Peitai, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua Ou tofia outou e avea o ni tausimea i lo’u fale, o tausimea moni lava.

verses.en: And for this purpose I have commanded you to organize yourselves, even to print my words, the fulness of my scriptures, the revelations which I have given unto you, and which I shall, hereafter, from time to time give unto you—
verses.sm: Ma o le faamoemoe lenei na Ou poloaiina ai outou e faatulaga outou lava, e lomia lava a’u upu, le atoatoaga o a’u tusitusiga paia, o faaaliga ua Ou tuuina atu ia te outou, ma ia o le a Ou tuu atu, mulimuli ane, ia te outou, mai lea taimi i lea taimi—

verses.en: For the purpose of building up my church and kingdom on the earth, and to prepare my people for the time when I shall dwell with them, which is nigh at hand.
verses.sm: Mo le faamoemoe o le atia’eina o la’u ekalesia ma le malo i luga o le lalolagi, ma saunia ai lo’u nuu mo le taimi o le a Ou mau faatasi ai ma i latou, ua lata lava ona oo mai.

verses.en: And ye shall prepare for yourselves a place for a treasury, and consecrate it unto my name.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou saunia mo outou lava se nofoaga mo se faleteuoloa, ma faapaia mo lo’u igoa.

verses.en: And ye shall appoint one among you to keep the treasury, and he shall be ordained unto this blessing.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou tofia se tasi i totonu o outou e tausia le faleteuoloa, ma ia faauuina o ia i lenei faamanuiaga.

verses.en: And there shall be a seal upon the treasury, and all the sacred things shall be delivered into the treasury; and no man among you shall call it his own, or any part of it, for it shall belong to you all with one accord.
verses.sm: Ma ia i ai se faamaufaailoga i luga o le faleteuoloa, ma ia avatu mea paia uma i le faleteuoloa; ma ia leai se tagata i totonu o outou na te ta’ua o lana lava, po o se vaega o lena mea, ona o le a ou e outou uma ma le agaga autasi.

verses.en: And I give it unto you from this very hour; and now see to it, that ye go to and make use of the stewardship which I have appointed unto you, exclusive of the sacred things, for the purpose of printing these sacred things as I have said.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu le faleteuoloa ia te outou mai lenei lava itula; ma o lenei ia vaai, ia outou o atu ma faaaoga le mea-tausi ua Ou tofi atu ia te outou, vagana ai mea paia, mo le faamoemoe o le lomia o nei mea paia e pei ona Ou fai atu ai.

verses.en: And the avails of the sacred things shall be had in the treasury, and a seal shall be upon it; and it shall not be used or taken out of the treasury by any one, neither shall the seal be loosed which shall be placed upon it, only by the voice of the order, or by commandment.
verses.sm: Ma o tupe o mea paia ia teuina i le faleteuoloa, ma ia tuu i ai i ona luga se faamaufaailoga; ma ia lē faaaogaina pe aveesea i fafo o le faleteuoloa e soo se tasi, pe tatalaina le faamaufaailoga e tuu i ai i ona luga, tau lava i le leo o le faatulagaga, po o se poloaiga.

verses.en: And thus shall ye preserve the avails of the sacred things in the treasury, for sacred and holy purposes.
verses.sm: Ma ia faapea ona outou tausi o tupe o mea paia i le faleteuoloa, mo faamoemoega sa ma paia.

verses.en: And this shall be called the sacred treasury of the Lord; and a seal shall be kept upon it that it may be holy and consecrated unto the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma ia ta’ua lenei mea o le faleteuoloa paia o le Alii; ma ia tuu i ai i ona luga se faamaufaailoga ina ia paia ma faapaiaina mo le Alii.

verses.en: And again, there shall be another treasury prepared, and a treasurer appointed to keep the treasury, and a seal shall be placed upon it;
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ia i ai se isi faleteuoloa e saunia, ma se teuoloa e tofi e tausia le faleteuoloa, ma ia tuu i ai i ona luga se faamaufaailoga;

verses.en: And all moneys that you receive in your stewardships, by improving upon the properties which I have appointed unto you, in houses, or in lands, or in cattle, or in all things save it be the holy and sacred writings, which I have reserved unto myself for holy and sacred purposes, shall be cast into the treasury as fast as you receive moneys, by hundreds, or by fifties, or by twenties, or by tens, or by fives.
verses.sm: Ma o tupe uma tou te maua ia outou mea-tausi, i le faaleleia atili o meatotino na Ou tofi atu ia te outou, i fale, po o i laueleele, po o i faatoaga manu, po o i mea uma lava vagana ai tusitusiga sa ma paia, ia ua Ou faapolopoloina mo a’u lava mo faamoemoega sa ma paia, ia lafo atu i le faleteuoloa i le vave lava tou te maua ai tupe, i le taiselau, po o le tailimasefulu, po o le tailuasefulu, po o le taisefulu, po o le tailima.

verses.en: Or in other words, if any man among you obtain five dollars let him cast them into the treasury; or if he obtain ten, or twenty, or fifty, or an hundred, let him do likewise;
verses.sm: Pe faapea, afai e maua e se tagata i totonu o outou se lima tālā, ia tuu atu ia te ia e lafo atu i le faleteuoloa; pe afai e maua e ia le sefulu, po o le luasefulu, po o le limasefulu, po o le selau, ia tuu atu ia te ia ia faapea ona faia;

verses.en: And let not any among you say that it is his own; for it shall not be called his, nor any part of it.
verses.sm: Ma ia lē tuu atu i se tasi i totonu o outou e fai mai o lea mea o lana lava; ona o le a lē ta’ua lea mea o sana, po o se vaega o lea mea.

verses.en: And there shall not any part of it be used, or taken out of the treasury, only by the voice and common consent of the order.
verses.sm: Ma ia leai se vaega o lea mea e faaaogaina, pe aveeseina mai le faleteuoloa, tau lava i le leo ma le finagalo autasi o le faatulagaga.

verses.en: And this shall be the voice and common consent of the order—that any man among you say to the treasurer: I have need of this to help me in my stewardship—
verses.sm: Ma o le leo lenei ma le finagalo autasi o le faatulagaga— soo se tagata o i totonu o outou e fai atu i le teuoloa: Ua ou manaomia le mea lenei e fesoasoani ia te a’u i la’u mea-tausi—

verses.en: If it be five dollars, or if it be ten dollars, or twenty, or fifty, or a hundred, the treasurer shall give unto him the sum which he requires to help him in his stewardship—
verses.sm: Afai o le mea ua manaomia o le lima tālā, po o le sefulu tālā, po o le luasefulu, po o le limasefulu, po o se selau, ia tuu atu e le teuoloa ia te ia le aofai ua manaomia e ia e fesoasoani ia te ia i lana mea-tausi—

verses.en: Until he be found a transgressor, and it is manifest before the council of the order plainly that he is an unfaithful and an unwise steward.
verses.sm: Sei vagana ua maua o ia o se solitulafono, ma ua faaalia manino i luma o le aufono a le faatulagaga o ia o se tausimea lē faamaoni ma lē atamai.

verses.en: But so long as he is in full fellowship, and is faithful and wise in his stewardship, this shall be his token unto the treasurer that the treasurer shall not withhold.
verses.sm: Ae a o i ai pea o ia i le faaaumeaga atoa, ma o faamaoni ma atamai i lana mea-tausi, o lana faailoga lea i le teuoloa ia lē taofia ai e le teuoloa.

verses.en: But in case of transgression, the treasurer shall be subject unto the council and voice of the order.
verses.sm: Ae i le tulaga o le solitulafono, e pulea le teuoloa e le aufono ma le leo o le faatulagaga.

verses.en: And in case the treasurer is found an unfaithful and an unwise steward, he shall be subject to the council and voice of the order, and shall be removed out of his place, and another shall be appointed in his stead.
verses.sm: Ma afai e maua o le teuoloa o se tausimea lē faamaoni ma lē atamai, e pulea o ia e le aufono ma le leo o le faatulagaga, ma aveese o ia mai lona nofoaga, ma tofia se isi i lona tulaga.

verses.en: And again, verily I say unto you, concerning your debts—behold it is my will that you shall pay all your debts.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e faatatau ia outou aitalafu— faauta o lo’u loto e tatau ona outou totogi a outou aitalafu uma.

verses.en: And it is my will that you shall humble yourselves before me, and obtain this blessing by your diligence and humility and the prayer of faith.
verses.sm: Ma o lo’u loto e tatau ona outou faamaualaloina outou lava i o’u luma, ma maua lenei faamanuiaga i lo outou filiga ma le lotomaualalo ma le tatalo o le faatuatua.

verses.en: And inasmuch as you are diligent and humble, and exercise the prayer of faith, behold, I will soften the hearts of those to whom you are in debt, until I shall send means unto you for your deliverance.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo outou filiga ma le lotomaualalo, ma faaaoga le tatalo o le faatuatua, faauta, o le a Ou faamaluluina loto o i latou o e ua outou aitalafu ai, seia Ou auina atu mea ia te outou mo lo outou laveaiina.

verses.en: Therefore write speedily to New York and write according to that which shall be dictated by my Spirit; and I will soften the hearts of those to whom you are in debt, that it shall be taken away out of their minds to bring affliction upon you.
verses.sm: O lea ia tusi vave atu i Niu Ioka ma tusi atu e tusa ma mea o le a faatonuina e lo’u Agaga; ma o le a Ou faamaluluina loto o i latou o e ua outou aitalafu ai, o le a aveesea ai mai o latou mafaufau le aumaia o puapuaga i o outou luga.

verses.en: And inasmuch as ye are humble and faithful and call upon my name, behold, I will give you the victory.
verses.sm: Ma e tusa ai ma lo outou lotomaualalo ma faamaoni ma valaau mai i lo’u igoa, faauta, o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou le manumalo.

verses.en: I give unto you a promise, that you shall be delivered this once out of your bondage.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se folafolaga, o le a laveaiina outou i le taimi e tasi lenei i fafo mai lo outou nofo pologa.

verses.en: Inasmuch as you obtain a chance to loan money by hundreds, or thousands, even until you shall loan enough to deliver yourself from bondage, it is your privilege.
verses.sm: E tusa ai ma lo outou maua o se avanoa e nonō ai tupe taiselau, po o le taiafe, seia oo ina lava tupe tou te nonōina e laveai ai outou mai le nofo pologa, o lo outou avanoa lena.

verses.en: And pledge the properties which I have put into your hands, this once, by giving your names by common consent or otherwise, as it shall seem good unto you.
verses.sm: Ma folafola atu meatotino ua Ou tuuina atu i o outou lima, i le taimi lenei e tasi, i le tuu atu o o outou igoa i le finagalo autasi po o se isi ala, e pei ona foliga lelei ia te outou.

verses.en: I give unto you this privilege, this once; and behold, if you proceed to do the things which I have laid before you, according to my commandments, all these things are mine, and ye are my stewards, and the master will not suffer his house to be broken up. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ou te tuu atu ia te outou lenei avanoa, i le taimi lenei e tasi; ma faauta, afai tou te aga atu e fai mea ua Ou tuuina atu i o outou luma, e tusa ma a’u poloaiga, o nei mea uma e a a’u ia, ma o outou o a’u tausimea, ma e lē tuua e le matai lona fale ia lepetia. E faapea lava. Amene.
